verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a fair question for a billing SaaS platform, so the axis applies. The evidence documents a hosted MCP server, a docs MCP, agent skills, server-side SDKs, an OpenAPI spec and a Postman collection, but no Paddle command-line tool. The plugins for Claude Code, Codex and Gemini CLI run inside third-party CLIs and are not a Paddle CLI, and the MCP server and SDKs are adjacent capabilities that earn no credit here.
